request.heading: Is this your device?
request.asks: {client} asks to sign you in on a device showing the code {code}.
request.warning: Approve only a device in front of you that you started signing in yourself. Somebody who sent you this code is asking you to sign THEM in as you.
find.heading: Sign in a device
find.sub: A television, a console or a command line that shows a code and this address is asking you to sign in here instead (RFC 8628).
find.off: Signing in this way is turned off here.
done.approved: Approved: the device is signing you in.
